body: 13 Nov 2026 evening, first measurement on the A35 (build 144, airplane mode, volume 0): pressing Play on the half-downloaded '00s Hip Hop playlist started the downloaded song 'In Da Club' (source=file) with resolve=19 ms, setSources=112 ms, span play.tap->playing 161 ms and play.audible 362 ms. So from the playlist Play button the offline start is NOT about a second. The owner's 'about 1 s' is another path: measure a tap on a song row, a tap from Search, from the Downloaded shelf, and the first start after the app was opened (cold) with the same spans (adb logcat -s flutter, lines '[perf] span play.tap->playing'). One sample is not a measurement: repeat each path 5 times.
